speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The Police also regularly engage the security guards at Paya Lebar Square, 1KM Mall and City Plaza.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The security guards are advised to look out for suspicious behavior and highlight any issues to the Police immediately.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
text: Much as we know the foreign workers are generally well-behaved, we cannot run away from the fact that such congregations do offer a fertile soft target for other groups to infiltrate, which include, from my regular walks and observations, drug-related and other unhealthy illegal activities.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
text: We also cannot run away from the fact that such congregations may be viewed as an ethnic-based congregation, especially in certain areas.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
text: These are the concerns and I was wondering whether the Ministry is keeping a close eye and what else we can do instead of just keeping a close eye on the area.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: I have earlier articulated in my reply that efforts put in by the Police to engage directly the foreign guest population who congregate around the area, as well as with the security guards in the malls around which these workers congregate.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: There are also Auxiliary Police Officers on the ground.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Certainly, we will be prepared to engage the hon Member on further measures if she thinks they are necessary to manage the situation on the ground.
